r.s: The plugins for PEAR_PackageFileManager to pick up what files to use, supported are File, CVS, SVN, Git, Perforce
r.d:
The plugins for PEAR_PackageFileManager to pick up what files to use. Supported are * File * CVS * SVN * Git * Perforce
This package is to be used with PackageFileManager v1 and v2 and can't be used on it's own
r.n: * PHP 7 compliance * Import PEAR_PackageFileManager_Git from pear.vardump.org. * Make unit tests portable, resilient, work
